name: Leadpages
summary: Landing pages, pop-ups and alert bars, with unlimited traffic on every Leadpages plan where metered rivals count visitors. The value pick rather than the optimisation pick.
best_for: small businesses building landing pages and simple funnels who want unmetered traffic — no per-visitor anxiety, unlike metered rivals
skip_if: you need deep A/B experimentation or enterprise features — the Conversion tier jumps to $299/mo fast
honest_knock: It's the value pick, not the optimisation pick — if you're spending big on ads, Unbounce's Smart Traffic and Instapage's 1:1 personalisation go deeper.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-03 against Leadpages' own machine-readable pricing file, which still carries the same 2026-07-10 update date it had in August and September; USD) Two lines, six paid plans, no free plan, and a 7-day free trial that requires a credit card and converts unless you cancel. Publishing plans: Starter $10/mo or $8 billed annually ($96 a year), 5 pages, 1 site, no third-party integrations; Pro $29/mo or $23 annually ($276), 25 pages, 1 blog, API access; Business $49/mo or $39 annually ($468), 50 pages, 2 sites. None of those three include A/B testing. Optimization plans add testing and personalisation: Grow $99/mo or $79 annually ($948), unlimited pages, 4 sites, manual two-way A/B testing, dynamic text replacement and lead enrichment; Optimize $199/mo or $159 annually ($1,908), 6 sites, up to four variants, Smart Traffic, heatmaps and auto-personalisation; Scale $399/mo or $319 annually ($3,828), 10 sites, auto-optimisation, cross-page learning, role-based access and 10 seats. Annual billing is 20% off across the board. No plan has a traffic cap. Add-ons: $20 a month per extra seat or extra custom domain, $40 per extra client workspace on Scale, and AI credit top-ups from $2.50 for 2,000 credits down to $0.60 per thousand at the largest pack. One caveat for buyers outside the US: read from a European connection on 3 October 2026, the pricing page itself switched to euros, and the two optimisation tiers cost more there than the USD list suggests — Grow €115 a month (€91.67 billed annually) and Optimize €229 (€183.33), against $99 and $199. Starter, Pro, Business and Scale showed the same numerals in euros as in dollars.
